title: Photo Speaks My Short Script
tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

exact_text.text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
exact_text.read_as: Hi everyone, thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

faults.what: The video is only 5.1 seconds long, rather than the explicitly requested 8 seconds.

judge.summary: The square video preserves the woman's likeness and speaks the complete script without captions, but it is only 5.1 seconds instead of 8.

must_haves.item: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
must_haves.why: The facial features, curly hair, sweater, and park setting remain recognizably consistent with the portrait.

must_haves.item: The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcription contains all requested words and no additional words; the punctuation difference does not change the spoken script.

must_haves.item: Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
must_haves.why: The frames show clearly changing mouth shapes and expressions, confirming animation, but precise speech synchronization cannot be verified from sampled stills and an untimed transcript.

must_haves.item: The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.
must_haves.why: One square video and audible English speech are evidenced, but the stated runtime is 5.1 seconds, not 8. The voice's gender and friendliness cannot be verified from the transcript.
No captions or other text appear in any supplied output frame.
